flow_summary: The system repeatedly failed to recover or clarify when the confused patient expressed uncertainty about question formats (DOB, postal code, email, phone), responding only with bare repetitions instead of breaking the request down or explaining. Early name-format query was ignored; several later history questions were reasonably followed up, but the pattern of non-adaptive repetition dominated.

Turn 1-2: Patient asks about name format; interviewer immediately switches to gender without acknowledgment.
